phase: 1 - grooming and training end-to-end, driven in a real browser with demo data
title: A governed refusal was double-encoded, so the customer was shown the envelope instead of the sentence
measured: Seen against the real POST handler while probing the authorization boundary for P1-04.
root_cause: app/api/canonical-bookings/route.ts caught a thrown Response and re-wrapped error.text() as {error:<text>}. Governance modules throw two shapes: a plain sentence (lib/training-commercial-governance.ts, lib/boarding-governance.ts) and a JSON envelope (lib/sitting-governance.ts and the auth layer, via governedJsonError). Reading both as plain text put the serialised envelope into the field the UI renders.
fix: app/api/canonical-bookings/route.ts: a governedRefusalBody helper re-emits the governance module's OWN envelope when the thrown Response carried one, so the sentence reaches the customer AND the fields a module authored for a client (lib/grooming-policy-governance.ts sends code/cityId/zoneId) stay at the top level instead of being flattened into a string. A plain-sentence throw is passed through untouched.
regression: tests/ptja-p1-governed-refusal-envelope.test.mjs - 3 cases against the real POST handler

red_first.P1-E02: RED - the customer was shown {"error":"Authentication required"} inside the error field

non_vacuity_controls_green_throughout: P1-E01 - a Sitting commercial refusal still arrives as its own sentence
P1-E03 - a plain-text Training refusal is unchanged by the fix

sabotage.control: revert to reading the whole body as text
sabotage.result: RED - P1-E02 only; both controls stayed GREEN
RED - the rewritten status case in tests/grooming-missing-policy-response.test.mjs

severity: Same class as P1-01: not security, not money - the difference between a customer who reads a sentence and one who reads a JSON blob.
not_claimed: Only the canonical-bookings handler was corrected. Other routes that re-wrap a thrown Response have not been swept.

shadowed_test_found.case: canonical booking preserves thrown governed response status instead of converting it to 500
shadowed_test_found.what: It asserted the catch clause's exact SOURCE TEXT with a regex, so it broke the moment that clause was corrected - even though the behaviour it names was preserved and improved. A source-text pin cannot distinguish a change that breaks the behaviour from one that fixes it.
shadowed_test_found.how_it_was_updated: Rewritten to drive the real handler: a governance module that throws a 409 Response must come back as a 409 carrying its own sentence, never a 500 and never an envelope. Verified by sabotage: forcing status 500 turns it red.
shadowed_test_found.honest_limit: That case does NOT go red under the raw-text sabotage, because the Training refusal it drives is a plain sentence and so is unaffected by the envelope change. The envelope behaviour is covered by P1-E02 instead. Two cases, two properties - said plainly rather than claimed as one.

not_covered: lib/grooming-policy-governance.ts throws an envelope carrying code/cityId/zoneId. The fix re-emits those fields, but this harness stops earlier at a plain-text grooming refusal, so field preservation is implemented and NOT pinned by a case. Recorded rather than asserted loosely.
